messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Let me create a fun, detailed SVG illustration. I'll draw:
- A bicycle (wheels with spokes, frame, handlebars, seat, pedals)
- A pelican body sitting on the seat (white body, wing, long beak with pouch, eye, legs to pedals)

Let me plan coordinates on a ~800x600 viewBox. Ground line at y=500. Wheels: rear wheel center (220, 430) r=70, front wheel center (560, 430) r=70. Frame connecting. Pelican sitting above the seat around (330, 300), body, neck curving up, head around (480, 200), long beak extending right with pouch.

I'll write clean SVG with groups and reasonable styling.

Let me draft the bicycle:
- Rear wheel: circle cx=220 cy=430 r=70, inner hub, spokes
- Front wheel: cx=560 cy=430 r=70
- Frame: seat tube from seat (330,320) to bottom bracket (390,430); chain stay from (390,430) to rear hub (220,430); top tube from seat area to head tube (500,340); down tube from bottom bracket to head tube; fork from head tube to front hub.
- Handlebars at (505,320).
- Seat at (330,315).
- Pedals/cranks at bottom bracket (390,430): crank arms.

Pelican: body ellipse around (320,280), tail pointing left, wing, neck from body up-right to head (450,190), head circle r~22, beak from head to (570,215) long with pouch curve below, eye. Legs from body down to pedal. Feet on pedals.

Make sure pelican body sits on the seat: seat around (320,310). Body ellipse cx=310 cy=275 rx=70 ry=45. Tail triangle to left ~ (230,260)-(250,300). Neck: path curving from (350,240) up to (440,195). Head circle at (450,190) r=22. Beak: from (462,185) to (585,210), pouch: curve down from (465,205) to (545,235) back to beak tip (585,210). Eye at (455,182).

Wing: ellipse/shape on body, maybe wing tip as "arm" reaching toward handlebar at (500,320)? Cute: wing reaching to handlebar. Draw path from body (380,260) to handlebar (505,325).

Legs: two paths from body bottom (~340,310) down to pedals. Pedal positions: crank at (390,430), crank arm to pedal at (410,400) and (370,460). One leg to each pedal.

Also add ground shadow line.

Let me finalize code with fills and slight stroke details. Add caption text maybe.

Wheel spokes: lines through hub.

Let me write SVG.

Key features:
- **Bicycle**: spoked wheels, classic diamond frame, handlebars, saddle, crank and red pedals
- **Pelican**: plump white body on the seat, tail feathers, a wing stretched forward to grip the handlebar, curved neck, and the signature long orange beak with its expandable throat pouch
- **Legs** reach down to the pedals with webbed feet

Save it as `pelican.svg` (or drop it into an HTML page) and open in a browser to see it ride.
